view.projectionFormula: clip = (world + PreViewTranslation,1) @ TranslatedWorldToClip; ndc = clip.xyz/clip.w; screen.x = rect.x + (ndc.x*0.5+0.5)*rect.w; screen.y = rect.y + (0.5-ndc.y*0.5)*rect.h

selection.rule: over all dispatched card-tile groups: mapped page, tile inside page, atlas coord inside 4096x4096, non-zero encoded albedo, non-emissive-dominated cached-pre-exposed final; prefer a floor-like card (|world normal Z|>0.7 and origin Z<300 cm) visible in the hero view, then a visible valid card with non-zero captured direct lighting, then lower-half visible cards, then luminance

material.albedoEncoding: BC7 stores sqrt(linear diffuse albedo) (encoded albedo). DecodeSurfaceCacheAlbedo squares it, then applies DiffuseOverrideParameter.w/.rgb and DiffuseColorBoost (=1 here).
material.albedoNormalization: PF_BC7 readback is expanded float16, not native BC bits. The replay snaps the decoded channels to the 1/255 UNORM8 grid to model hardware BC7 sampling. Selected texel raw expanded (0.3999023, 0.3764648, 0.3371582) -> snapped (102,96,86)/255 = (0.4,0.37647,0.33725). The snap is a model of the UNORM8 sampler, not a bit-exact BC7 block decode.
material.normalDecode: BC5 stores encoded xy; xy=2*storedRG-1, z=sqrt(1-xy^2), sign taken from the card world normal
material.note: No material asset name is present in DumpGPU; these are the captured material attributes of the selected card texel. The albedo is encoded (sqrt of linear albedo), not linear albedo.

albedo.formula: q = uv * extent - 0.5; lo = floor(q); t = q - lo; bilinear over lo+(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)
albedo.encoding: BC7 encoded albedo (sqrt of linear rho); raw expanded selected texel (0.3999023,0.3764648,0.3371582), snapped to (102,96,86)/255. The squared value, not this encoded value, is the linear albedo.

emissive.formula: q = uv * extent - 0.5; lo = floor(q); t = q - lo; bilinear over lo+(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)

direct.formula: q = uv * extent - 0.5; lo = floor(q); t = q - lo; bilinear over lo+(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)

indirect.formula: q = uv * extent - 0.5; lo = floor(q); t = q - lo; bilinear over lo+(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)

taps.filterFootnote: At an exact texel-centre UV the four bilinear weights are (1,0,0,0); all four captured values are retained.

values.encodedAlbedoNote: The BC7 albedo atlas stores EncodedAlbedo = sqrt(linear diffuse albedo); CombineFinalLighting decodes it as EncodedAlbedo^2 before the /pi Lambert term. The 0.4 value is therefore encoded albedo, and rho = 0.16, not 0.4.
values.storedFinalTimesViewPreExposureNote: Partial transform only: cached-pre-exposed final * View.PreExposure. It does not remove CachedLightingPreExposure and is not display-linear.
values.cachedLightingPreExposureSource: captured pass 684 'Batched lights' parameter block: CachedLightingPreExposure=0.0625, View.PreExposure=0.00048828125; LumenSceneDirectLighting.usf:163 writes Irradiance*CachedLightingPreExposure. The same view's world pass also records RadianceCacheOneOverCachedLightingPreExposure=16.0.
values.exposureNote: Lumen.SceneFinalLighting stores cached-lighting pre-exposed radiance: linear radiance * CachedLightingPreExposure (1/16). Un-pre-exposed radiance = stored*16; view-pre-exposed scene color = stored*16*View.PreExposure (1/2048). LumenSurfaceCacheSampling.ush:312-314 applies the *16 on read. The store is not view-pre-exposed and the old stored*View.PreExposure value is not display-linear.

formulas.pageDecode: page = PageBuffer[pageIndex*5 .. +4]; CardIndex=asuint(V0.x); SizeInTexels=V0.zw; CardUVRect=V1; PhysicalAtlasUVRect=V2; PhysicalAtlasCoord=floor(rect.xy*PhysicalAtlasSize+0.5)
formulas.combine: Final_cachedPreExposed = max((Direct_cachedPreExposed+Indirect_cachedPreExposed)*(EncodedAlbedo^2*DiffuseOverride.w+DiffuseOverride.rgb)/pi + Emissive_cachedPreExposed, 0); CombineFinalLighting's DecodeSurfaceCacheAlbedo squares the encoded albedo
formulas.albedoDecode: rho = EncodedAlbedo^2 * DiffuseOverrideParameter.w + DiffuseOverrideParameter.xyz (DiffuseColorBoost=1). BC7 stores sqrt(rho).
formulas.exposure: cachedPreExposed = linear_radiance * CachedLightingPreExposure (1/16); unPreExposed = cachedPreExposed*16; viewPreExposed = unPreExposed*View.PreExposure (1/2048).

coverageGaps: DumpGPU does not record the compiled shader permutation or a per-thread query. The card tile is a declared replay over captured state, not a witnessed dispatched hit.
The capture has no mesh asset or material name for the Lumen card. Captured identity is CardIndex/MeshCardsIndex/SceneInstanceIndex plus the world OBB; the name is not invented.

BC7/BC5 readback is exporter-expanded float (NativeFormatExpanded=True, StoredBytesAreNativeStorage=False), not native BC block bits. The replay snaps the decoded channels to the 1/255 UNORM8 grid to model hardware BC7/BC5 sampling; this is a modeling approximation, not a bit-exact block decode. About 11% of albedo texels are off the 1/255 grid (max 0.123/255), so the snap is not a lossless recovery. The selected albedo texel's raw expanded float16 is (0.3999023,0.3764648,0.3371582) and snaps to (102,96,86)/255. BC6H remains float.
The card/page selection is a declared rule over the captured tile list; the GPU GroupId scheduling order is not captured per thread.
The captured surface DispatchCardTilesIndirectArgs holds two triples, (62,1,1) and (3953,1,1); DumpGPU does not record which one the dispatch consumed. The replay evaluates the second (3953 groups).
